name: MRDIY
recent: MRDIY 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收同比增长 4.8%，但净利同比下降 6.4% 至 RM127.3 million，主要受支出上升影响。公司宣布派发每股 0.013 仙的中期单层股息，总额约 RM123.2 million。此外，EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年中期单层股息每股 RM0.013，总额约 RM123.2 million。
公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收同比增长 4.8%，净利同比下降 6.4% 至 RM127.3 million。
EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 净利同比下降 6.4%，支出上升。
公司放缓马来西亚门店扩张计划。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收同比增长 4.8%，但净利同比下降 6.4% 至 RM127.3 million；净利率从去年同期的 14.0% 降至 10.7%。

recent_en: MRDIY reported 3QFY2026 results with revenue up 4.8% year-on-year, but net profit fell 6.4% to RM127.3 million due to higher expenses. The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.013 sen per share, totaling approximately RM123.2 million. EPF also made multiple substantial shareholder filings between October and November.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of RM0.013 per share for FY2026, totaling approximately RM123.2 million.
Announced 3QFY2026 results with revenue up 4.8% year-on-year and net profit down 6.4% to RM127.3 million.
EPF made multiple substantial shareholder filings between October and November.
risks_en: Net profit fell 6.4% year-on-year amid rising expenses.
The company slowed its store expansion plan in Malaysia.
earnings_en: 3QFY2026 revenue grew 4.8% year-on-year, but net profit fell 6.4% to RM127.3 million; net margin declined to 10.7% from 14.0% a year earlier.
